title: dotMod
description: Client-side Fabric PvP/survival utility mod with quick craft, draggable HUD editor, local player name colors, and toggle sneak.
body:
# dotMOD

**dotMOD** is a lightweight client-side Fabric utility mod for Minecraft 1.21.11, focused on PvP and survival quality-of-life features.

The mod adds a small set of configurable client tools: quick crafting from selected inventory slots, a draggable HUD editor, local player name coloring, and toggle sneak.

## Features

### Quick Craft

Adds a `Craft` button to the player inventory and crafting table screen.

When pressed, dotMOD moves items from configured inventory slots into the crafting grid using normal client click actions.

Default source slots:

**2x2 player inventory:**
- 9
- 10
- 18
- 19

**3x3 crafting table:**
- 9
- 10
- 11
- 18
- 19
- 20
- 27
- 28
- 29

Source slots are configured as logical player inventory slots, not raw GUI slot ids.

### HUD Editor

Adds a `HUD` button to the inventory and creative inventory.

The HUD Editor lets you move selected vanilla HUD elements by dragging them with the mouse.

Supported elements include:

- Hearts
- Armor
- Hunger
- Hotbar
- Experience bar / level positions in config
- Status effects
- Bossbar
- Scoreboard

The editor includes:
- draggable element frames
- element labels
- reset button
- optional grid snapping
- saved `dx/dy` offsets

### Name Colors

dotMOD lets you locally recolor the name of the player you are looking at.

Default keybinds:

- `G` - color targeted player green
- `R` - color targeted player red
- `V` - reset targeted player's name color

Colors are stored by player UUID and only affect your own client.

Supported displays:

- Nameplate above the player
- Tab list name, when possible

Optional chat notifications can be enabled in the config.

### Toggle Shift

Adds a toggle sneak keybind.

Default keybind:

- `Right Shift`

When enabled, your sneak key is held client-side until you toggle it off again. Normal physical sneak still works as usual.

## Configuration

dotMOD has a Mod Menu + Cloth Config settings screen.

Config sections:

- General
- Quick Craft
- HUD Editor
- Name Colors
- Toggle Shift
- Keybinds info

The config is client-only and saved between game launches.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu
- Cloth Config API

## Notes

dotMOD is fully client-side.  
It does not add server-side content and does not require installation on the server.

HUD movement is designed for vanilla HUD behavior. Compatibility with large HUD overhaul mods may vary.
